description: Kwaliteit van drinkwater in Nederland (2012) is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. In deze dataset zijn de jaargemiddelde concentraties van stoffen in het drinkwater opgenomen per drinkwaterpompstation. De metingen zijn uitgevoerd door de drinkwaterbedrijven daar waar het drinkwater na zuivering het pompstation verlaat. Alleen de meetresultaten boven de detectiegrens zijn weergegeven. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WFS_SRVC, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WMS_SRVC. The portal shows 2026-09-11 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
